summary: This 8-K reports the closing of a securitization by GM Financial Consumer Automobile Receivables Trust 2026-3, an asset-backed securities (ABS) issuer. On July 15, 2026, the trust issued $1.01579 billion in notes (Classes A-1 through C) and a certificate, backed by prime auto loans. The publicly offered notes were registered and sold via Mizuho Securities. This is a routine ABS issuance, not an M&A or special situation. The filing is a current report under Item 1.01 required by an SEC undertaking to evidence final agreements. No special-situation elements such as a takeover, activist campaign, or restructuring are present.
